summary: Establishes a popup bridge WebSocket client to connect to Cables Electron Standalone (e.g. HttpFileServer) from cables.gl in a Chrome browser with full pub/sub channel compatibility.

ports.name: URL
ports.text: The WebSocket server URL (e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:8080 or ws://localhost:8080).

ports.name: Protocols
ports.text: Optional subprotocol strings (comma-separated).

ports.name: Broadcast Channel Name
ports.text: Unique BroadcastChannel identifier linking the Cables patch and the popup bridge window.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Enable or disable connection.

ports.name: Auto Open Popup
ports.text: Automatically opens the popup bridge window on patch load / active.

ports.name: Auto Reconnect
ports.text: Automatically reconnects if the connection drops or server restarts.

ports.name: Reconnect Interval
ports.text: Time in seconds to wait before attempting to reconnect.

ports.name: Open Popup
ports.text: Trigger to open the popup bridge window.

ports.name: Close Popup
ports.text: Trigger to close the popup bridge window.

ports.name: Connect
ports.text: Trigger to connect the WebSocket.

ports.name: Disconnect
ports.text: Trigger to disconnect the WebSocket.

ports.name: Enable Message Log
ports.text: Toggle packet logging in the popup bridge window. Keep disabled for high-FPS streaming performance (e.g. 20-60 FPS mouse/sensor data).

ports.name: Send Channel
ports.text: Channel name for direct sending/publishing.

ports.name: Send Data
ports.text: Object payload for direct sending.

ports.name: Send Text
ports.text: String payload for direct sending.

ports.name: Send
ports.text: Trigger to publish the direct payload.

ports.name: Client Connection
ports.text: Connection object reference compatible with WebSocketClientSub, WebSocketClientPub, WebSocketSub, or WebSocketPub ops.

ports.name: Popup Open
ports.text: True when the popup window bridge is open.

ports.name: Connected
ports.text: True when the WebSocket client is actively connected to the server.

ports.name: Connecting
ports.text: True while the connection is being established.

ports.name: On Connected
ports.text: Fires when connection is established.

ports.name: On Disconnected
ports.text: Fires when connection is lost or closed.

ports.name: On Message
ports.text: Fires on any incoming message received from the server.

ports.name: Received Data
ports.text: Parsed JSON object or payload of the most recent message.

ports.name: Raw Message
ports.text: Unparsed raw string received from the server.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Current status: 'connected', 'connecting', 'disconnected', 'popup open', 'popup closed', or 'error'.

ports.name: Error
ports.text: Last error message if an error occurs.
